$comment: Deployment parameters. One profile is selected by ELIXIR_PROFILE (default testnet) and `bun run codegen` writes it into the Noir globals, the TS constants and the deploy arguments. Contracts are immutable: changing a value means a new deployment. T_MAX must equal 4 × EXPECTED_EPOCH_SECONDS; INITIAL_TARGET is the 128-bit threshold a ticket's low 128 bits must stay under.
$domains: Domain separators shared by the Noir circuits/contract and miner-core: the ASCII tag, big-endian, as one field. Generated into the work lib's domains.nr and miner-core's params.ts; a change here changes the work circuit and the ticket, i.e. a new deployment.
